# DashScope Python SDK

> Python SDK for [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Bailian) / DashScope](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/) — a single client library covering text generation, multimodal (vision/audio) understanding, text and multimodal embeddings, reranking, image and video generation, and speech synthesis & recognition.

Key features:
- One consistent `Model.call(...)` pattern across every domain: `Generation` (text), `CodeGeneration`, `MultiModalConversation` (vision, TTS, ASR), `ImageSynthesis`, `VideoSynthesis`, `TextEmbedding`, `MultiModalEmbedding`, `TextReRank`, `SpeechSynthesizer` (v1 + streaming CosyVoice v2), `Recognition`/`Transcription` (streaming + batch ASR), `Application` (Bailian agent apps), `FineTunes`/`Files`/`Deployments` (fine-tune and serve a model), local `Tokenizer`, `agentstudio.Client` (managed agents)
- Every field accepting a URL (images, audio, video) also accepts a local file path — auto-uploaded to OSS transparently
- Every call has a sync form and an `Aio`-prefixed `async`/`await` form (`AioGeneration`, `AioImageSynthesis`, ...)
- Built-in multi-region/workspace endpoint switching (`dashscope.set_region(...)`) and an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, with no extra `openai` dependency
- Bundled `dashscope` CLI (one sub-command per capability: `generation`, `files`, `ft`, `models`, `embeddings`, `rerank`, ...) plus an interactive terminal AI assistant (DashScope SDK Expert) for SDK/API Q&A

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/README.md): Installation, API key authentication, region/endpoint configuration, OpenAI-compatible chat completions, usage examples for every model family, streaming, async, error handling, logging, and response fields
- [README (中文)](https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/README_zh.md): 中文版完整指南（安装、鉴权、区域配置、各类模型的使用示例、流式输出、异步调用、错误处理）
- [README (日本語)](https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/README_ja.md): 日本語版の完全ガイド（インストール、認証、リージョン設定、各モデルの使用例、ストリーミング、非同期呼び出し、エラーハンドリング）

## Examples

All examples below are embedded directly in the README as runnable, copy-pasteable snippets:

- Quick start / streaming / async / error handling: https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/README.md#quick-start
- Text generation with `Generation`: https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/README.md#quick-start
- Vision understanding (including local image files), code generation, text/multimodal embeddings, rerank, image/video generation, TTS (batch and streaming CosyVoice v2), ASR (batch and streaming), Bailian Application calls, AgentStudio managed agents, local tokenization, fine-tuning, and deploying a fine-tuned model: https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/README.md#usage-examples
- Region/workspace switching and OpenAI-compatible completions: https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/README.md#region-and-endpoint-configuration
- Non-interactive CLI usage (`dashscope generation create`, `dashscope models list`, `dashscope files upload`, ...): https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/README.md#cli-usage
- Agentic RL fine-tuning (custom rollout/reward functions, YAML-driven jobs, tracing): https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/dashscope/finetune/reinforcement/examples/workspace/README.md and https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/blob/main/dashscope/finetune/reinforcement/examples/workspace/UserGuide.md
- Additional standalone runnable scripts: https://github.com/dashscope-sdk/dashcope-sdk-python/tree/main/samples
